    c.name AS card_name,
    MIN(s.release_date) AS release_date,
    STRING_AGG(DISTINCT l.format, ', ') AS0legal_formats

    cards c

    set_translations st ON c.setcode = st.setcode

question: For all the set of cards that has Japanese translation, what is the percentage of them are only available in non-foil?

predicted_sql:
-- Calculate the percentage of Japanese-translated cards that are only available in non-foil
WITH japanese_cards AS (
    SELECT c.id
    FROM cards c
    JOIN set_translations st ON c.setcode = st.setcode
    WHERE st.language = 'Japanese'
),
non_foil_only_cards AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM japanese_cards
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM cards c2
        WHERE c2.setcode = japanese_cards.setcode
          AND c2.name = japanese_cards.name
          AND c2.isfoil = 1
    )
)
SELECT 
    (COUNT(non_foil_only_cards.id::float) / COUNT(japanese_cards.id)) * 100 AS percentage_non_foil_only
FROM 
    japanese_cards
LEFT JOIN 
    non_foil_only_cards ON japanese_cards.id = non_foil_only_cards.id;
